messages:
alex kim: quick async check — can folks post one-line status for the quarterly Kickboard milestone? what shipped, what slipped, owners, and any quick unblock asks. trying to close the quarter summary by EOD :hourglass_flowing_sand:
maria gomez: shipped: kickoff doc + public API spec. owner: maria. slipped: analytics event schema (blocked by infra changes) — will need infra help, owner for unblock: priya. next step: prioritize event schema in backlog grooming :spiral_calendar:
jon (eng): shipped: backend + basic canary for prefetch cache. owner: eng-runtime. slipped: feature flag integration with Dedicated (edge cases around KV eviction). small spike needed, ETA 3 days. ask: @priya singh can you allocate 1 infra cycle to help with the API auth change?
priya singh: noted. I can do a half-day deep-dive tomorrow. blocking items: we need the service account rotation merged to staging (I left a tiny comment on the PR). once that's in, I can test Dedicated auth.
emily qa: QA status: smoke tests green on staging for prefetch cache, failing 2 flaky tests in concurrency suite around `kv-ttl` — investigating root cause. ETA for test fixes: end of day. will post a short flaky test ticket.
alex kim: thanks — can people paste PR links for the things they want reviewed? i'll nudge reviewers after lunch.
maria gomez: PRs: https://github.com/redwood-inference/kickboard/pull/412 (api schema), https://github.com/redwood-inference/kickboard/pull/409 (events pipeline) — both need 1 reviewer.
jon (eng): PRs: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/233 (prefetch canary), https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/237 (flag integration spike) — please review. small note: `rollout: canary=20%` in the helm overrides for prod canary.
priya singh: leaving review comments on #233 now. for the rotation PR: merge to staging command I used locally: ```
# locally merge branch to staging
git checkout staging
git pull origin staging
git merge --no-ff feature/sa-rotation
git push origin staging
```
emily qa: quick smoke command for reviewers who want to sanity-check staging endpoints: ```
curl -s -X POST https://staging.api.redwood.dev/kickboard/health -H "Authorization: Bearer $STAGING_TOKEN" | jq .status
```
deploy-bot: prod-canary deploy started for release/2026-01-kickboard (canary=20%). logs: https://ci.redwood.dev/builds/4452 :rocket:
jon (eng): deploy-bot — can you confirm fallback policy if canary error rate > 1%?
deploy-bot: fallback: automatic rollback to previous revision if 5xx rate exceeds 1% for 5m, and alert to #eng-oncall.
maria gomez: ownership clarifications: analytics schema — maria (product) owns the spec, eng to implement, infra to provide stable events infra. tagging: @jon (eng) owner for implementation, @priya singh owner for infra unblock.
alex kim: any cross-team deps not called out? e.g., legal, security, support?
maria gomez: security gave greenlight for the API spec yesterday (scanned for PII). support flagged a docs gap for Dedicated onboarding — i'll create a short help-center ticket and loop in docs.
jon (eng): quick CR ask — if you can review #233 by EOD I can re-run canary by tomorrow morning. reviewers: @alex kim, @maria gomez.
priya singh: re: infra allocation — i'll schedule the half-day as a calendar block and post the invite in this thread.
emily qa: will follow-up with the flaky test ticket link once created. also will post a short checklist for post-release smoke steps here.
pm-bot: reminder — quarterly OKR writeup template ready: https://docs.internal/redwood/okr-template — ping when you want me to create the draft.
alex kim: perfect. plan: (1) reviewers pinged, (2) priya rotates in infra time tomorrow, (3) emily posts flaky ticket + smoke checklist, (4) jon re-runs canary after reviews. if anything slips beyond 3 days, call it out here. tagging for visibility: @here :eyes:
jon (eng): noted, will post a follow-up status in this thread after the canary completes tomorrow morning.
priya singh: follow-up: invite sent for tomorrow 10:30am PT, calendar event includes links to staging and PRs.
emily qa: flaky test ticket: https://tracker.redwood.dev/tickets/8762 — added steps and screenshots.
alex kim: thanks everyone — i'll assemble the quarter summary and ship to leadership by EOD. if anyone has last-minute slips, post them here now. :thumbsup:
